what_went_wrong: A 13% price (168) was quoted inside a 12% price ladder (157 / 144).
check: Does every quoted price carry its own return, with one hurdle per rung?

what_went_wrong: Announced capex ($6-11B at NBIS) sat in the model without a source of funds.
check: Does the model's own net-cash path stay funded in every scenario (low point against the balance sheet and profit)?

what_went_wrong: The calibrated lens was read as a second opinion when the margin floor did not bind or the held multiple was inflated.
check: Is the second lens a real second opinion (margin floor binds, held multiple not inflated)?

what_went_wrong: The calibrated buy price was quoted at today's multiple; a rerun at that lower price holds a lower multiple and gives a lower price.
check: Is the quoted highest passing price the one a rerun at that price confirms?

what_went_wrong: A bear case with negative equity was shown as a price of 0.01.
check: Is a wiped scenario reported as wiped (value zero, return not shown), never as a small price?

what_went_wrong: Answers went out without the input that moves the value most and without the 2-year and 5-year ranges.
check: Does the answer name the most sensitive input and give the 2-year and 5-year bear-base-bull ranges?
source: CLAUDE.md (self-check of the 5-minute ticker check, 04.11.2026 and 15.11.2026); scripts/lean_model.py sensitivity, ranges

what_went_wrong: The reverse DCF was dominated by the margin path, so "the price assumes no growth after 2027" was overstated.
check: Is the growth the price needs also read at a flat margin, and does the reverse DCF solve?

what_went_wrong: A buy or sell call was made while the two lenses sat in different bands.
check: Do both lenses put the base case in the same band?
source: CLAUDE.md (two lenses before any buy/sell call, 05.11.2026); scripts/lean_model.py two_lens.agree

what_went_wrong: Price and value were compared in different units (ADR ratio, split).
check: Are the price and the value per the same share unit (ADR ratio, split date)?

what_went_wrong: A search for names that "fell a lot" returned broken companies that were not recovering.
check: Did the name pass the trend gates of the quality and momentum screen (not picked because it fell)?
source: CLAUDE.md (how to choose which stocks get a deep check, 15.11.2026); scripts/quality_momentum_screen.py

what_went_wrong: About $325M of one-quarter partnership revenue was left in the base year before growth was applied; revenue booked but not collected was read as a run rate.

check: Are converts (and their caps), puts, warrants, leases and legal judgments from the notes in net cash, shares or a charge? Name each or say there is none.

what_went_wrong: The margin after depreciation did not match the asset life used (4 against 5 years).

what_went_wrong: The guided year did not sit at the company guide (SPCX: first value 27.6 became 70 after a missed guidance; NBIS 2027 at the low end instead of the midpoint).
check: Is the guided year inside the company guide (revenue and margin), and are later years inside the evidence rather than at its floor?

what_went_wrong: The bull case ignored the company's record of beating its own guidance.

what_went_wrong: The bear had no company-specific hit (CRDO: loss of a customer; NU: a 2015-16 style credit cycle fails the -10% leg).

what_went_wrong: Locked judgement rules were not followed or not labelled (META capex path; NU beta 2.0 against the rule 1.15; APH exit P/E 20 against its own median 25).
check: Do beta, the exit P/E, the mature beta, the terminal ROIC, rf and ERP follow the locked rules, or state why not?

what_went_wrong: A buy answer carried claims that were not checked against a primary source.

what_went_wrong: A historical multiple from a faster-growth era was used as fair value.

what_went_wrong: The price went stale between the model run and delivery (130.25 to 123.18 in 30 minutes).
check: Is the price fresh (not older than 3 trading days, not moved more than 3% since the run)?

what_went_wrong: "Growth rates unchanged" hid a 26% rise of the revenue level in every later year after the 2028 level was rebased.
check: Against the previous valuation: is the absolute revenue and operating-profit path compared year by year, not only the growth rates?

what_went_wrong: Stock-based pay was held flat while revenue quadrupled, and capex fell to near zero after the surge with idle equipment not depreciated.
check: For an asset-heavy or fast-growing business: does stock-based pay scale with revenue, and does capex after the surge follow commitments and the pre-surge share?

what_went_wrong: The sell line drifts about 11% a year and went stale; some falsifiers were not measurable or not dated.
check: Is every falsifier measurable and dated, and is the sell line quoted with its date?

what_went_wrong: A change of the scenario odds alone moved the weighted value (-3.77) without being shown.
check: Against the previous valuation: is every changed input listed with its own value effect, the odds included?

what_went_wrong: A wrong contract id was used for a price snapshot; the company, the date and the size of the error are not recorded anywhere.
check: Does the contract of the price snapshot belong to the params ticker and exchange (state the symbol and exchange the quote came from)?

what_went_wrong: The value was not as of today: cash was discounted or counted twice.

what_went_wrong: The reverse DCF did not hold the guided year.
